nodes.name: ci-cd.yml
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions workflow that verifies every push and pull request against main (lint, test, build, typecheck) and, only on a push to main, builds and pushes the Docker image to Docker Hub.
nodes.languageNotes: Typecheck deliberately runs after Build because tsc depends on route types Next.js generates into .next/types during the build.

nodes.name: verify
nodes.summary: Quality-gate job that checks out the repo, installs dependencies with pnpm, then runs lint, tests, a production build, and typecheck on every push and PR.

nodes.name: docker
nodes.summary: Publish job, gated on the verify job and on pushes to main, that logs into Docker Hub, derives image tags, and builds/pushes the image with GitHub Actions layer caching and public NEXT_PUBLIC_* build args.
